mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic and noradrenergic activity with additive CNS depression and potential serotonin syndrome risk; atomoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 which may increase trazodone levels.
action: Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome, excessive sedation, and orthostatic hypotension; consider dose adjustment of trazodone if needed; educate patient on CNS depression risks.
